content: वर्गः [वृज्-घञ्] .²1 A class, division, group; company, society, tribe, collection (of similar things); न्यषेधि शेषोऽप्यनुयायिवर्गः <ls>R. 2. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 7</ls>; so पौरवर्गः, नक्षत्रवर्गः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A party, side; वर्गावुभौ देवमहीधराणाम् <ls>Ku. 7. 53</ls>. .²3 A category. .²4 A class of words grouped together; as मनुष्यवर्गः, वनस्पतिवर्गः <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 A class of consonants in the alphabet; (as कवर्ग, चवर्ग <ab>etc.</ab>). .²6 A section, chapter, division of a book. .²7 Particularly, a subdivision of an Adhyāya in Ṛgveda. .²8 The square power. .²9 Strength. .²10 Sphere, province. .²11 The whole class of objects of worldly existence (धर्म, अर्थ and काम).
